exercises.prompt: Match each part of a classical biographical name to its term:
exercises.explanation: Classical names distinguish kunya, ism, nasab, laqab, and nisbah.

exercises.prompt: True or False: Between two personal names on the same line (e.g., عُمَرُ بْنُ الخَطَّابِ), the initial alif of ابْنُ is dropped.
exercises.explanation: True. Orthographic convention drops the initial alif of ابْنُ when it stands between a son's and father's name.

feedback.rule: Drop alif of ابْنُ between two proper names.
